_comment: bge-gemma2 QAT int8 -- dual-objective stealth tuning, Trial 48 (ASR 0.959, trig 0.904, ctrl 0.856; nl=6). Env vars / CLI override these; any omitted key falls back to the code default. Dual-objective study => cosine-shift suppression OFF (eps=0, lam_supp=0); only drop/keep/clean active; clean anchored to honest INT -- set QUADRA_CLEAN_ANCHOR=int at train time (NOT a JSON key; trainer default is fp). 9B model => train_batch 1 to fit one 46GB GPU.
